scope: Read-only inspection of isolated navigation sandbox and portrait-final-polish Command Center preview

findings.finding: Command Center fetches data/kvk-opponent-intelligence-current.json directly from static host; no auth check was found in this preview's own JavaScript.
findings.implication: Treat preview JSON as publicly readable when deployed on public GitHub Pages; no confidentiality claims for contents.

findings.finding: Dataset identifies opponent #1913 and last update 2026-10-04, not a live game feed.
Iframe links to independent previews; iframe document load does not verify inner authentication, data completeness, or privileges.

releaseGates: Review whether the currently published static JSON contains only data authorized for public disclosure.
Validate Supabase RLS separately using authorized test accounts for public, member and R4/R5 roles.
Confirm any protected operations are performed server-side and never trusted to front-end navigation hiding.
Verify data source freshness and visibly distinguish snapshots from live game data.
Test mobile navigation and blank/error states on actual device.
policy: No privilege changes, secret exposure, production deployments or frozen design changes authorized by this audit.
